script.problem: It has 22 words. Each line is 20 words or fewer.
Its true detail "Babylon" is named in line 2, 3, which gives it away. Burn a detail no other line mentions.

terra.problem: The verses say Nebuchadnezzar summoned Jehoiachin and brought him to Babylon; they do not say where he was summoned.
The verses credit Nebuchadnezzar with carrying the survivors into exile, not specifically the Chaldeans.
